capabilities: Render a note as a Kanban board via frontmatter
Add and remove note cards in columns
Sort cards by name, modification date, or creation date
Embed note content and a daily rotating random note
Configure grid columns, board width, and embed height limits
disambiguation: Not a task Kanban board; cards link to existing notes and there is no task tracking or dragging between columns mentioned.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Localization currently covers English and Russian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pin and visually organize favorite notes as cards on a customizable board inside a note.
summary: Kanban-style dashboard plugin that renders any note as a board of cards linking to chosen vault notes, with columns, sorting, embeds and a daily random note.
